text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One day, an unexpected cloudburst<n>assails the
academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Like cats and dogs, indeed. What to<n>do, what to
do...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I bump into Symboli Rudolf, who<n>seems to be deep
in thought.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, quite all right, thank you. Only,<n>well... It seems
I have some free time<n>on my hands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I had student council business<n>outdoors today, but
it's been<n>postponed due to the rain.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I went to see what other duties I<n>could take care
of, but I found that Air<n>Groove had beaten me to
the punch.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She already had everything squared<n>firmly away.
Sometimes I feel like she<n>could run this council on
her own...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
In any case, as you can see, I am<n>now at a loss
for what to do with<n>myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A failing on my behalf, I suppose.<n>I've grown too
accustomed to having<n>a full schedule.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's what you're worried about?<n>But that's
simple!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello, Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Heya! You looked a little down in the<n>dumps, so I
thought I'd listen in! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I might have guessed. You have a<n>nose for drama.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: At any rate, what exactly is so<n>simple?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Duh! I mean what you should do with<n>your free
time! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look, if you don't know where to<n>start, just do
whatever pops into your<n>head!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see... So spontaneity is vital. The<n>willingness to
be carried away by a<n>whim.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Um... I guess? You don't have to<n>make everything
sound so serious.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Anyway, if you can't think of any<n>ideas...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you ask someone close<n>by for a
helping hand? ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's all for the drive-by<n>help sesh! I'm
sure you<n>whippersnappers can figure out the<n>rest.
Bye-bye now! ♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Whippersnappers? We're in the<n>same school
year...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: All the same, I see what she's<n>getting at.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It appears I must once again seek<n>your counsel,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What should I do with this abundance<n>of time
thrust upon me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An intriguing idea. I certainly wouldn't<n>want to
squander this opportunity...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hesitate to impose on you further,<n>but could I ask
you to assist me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have some truly excellent material in<n>my
notebook that I would like your<n>opinion on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I want you to be as frank as possible,<n>so please
don't hold back!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For the rest of the afternoon, Symboli<n>Rudolf
unleashes a barrage of jokes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's an experience too bizarre to<n>describe, but she
seems satisfied by<n>the results.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Research, you say? I certainly can't<n>fault your
diligent attitude.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, I can hardly let your enthusiasm<n>go
unanswered, can I?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Shall we make our way to your<n>office? There
should be some footage<n>of past races there that
we can<n>watch.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and I spend the rest of<n>the
afternoon watching all of the wet<n>weather race
videos we can find.
